observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha PSS-175 electronic keyboard.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is clearly printed on the top right of the control panel.
The model 'PSS-175' is printed on the bottom right of the control panel.
The keyboard has 61 keys (37 black and 24 white).
The unit is resting on a patterned fabric surface.
A watermark 'HERITAGE REAL ESTATE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The screen is off and the photo is a static shot.

claims.claim: please note but working perfectly well

risks.risk: The internal electronics may be faulty or the power supply may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powered on, the display active, and a successful chord or scale demonstration.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have a faulty or missing battery.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and the battery itself.

risks.risk: The keys may be stiff, sticky, or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of a person playing the keyboard to demonstrate key responsiveness.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a few chords.
Photo of the battery compartment and the battery.
Video of someone playing the keyboard to check key feel.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
